title: Improving Generalization in Coreference Resolution via Adversarial Training
reasoning: The paper focuses on adversarial training for coreference resolution systems and evaluates their performance on standard benchmarks like CoNLL-2012 and GAP. While it discusses gender-based performance gaps as a form of bias, it does not involve Large Language Models (focusing instead on ELMo and LSTMs) and has no component related to benchmarking or evaluating religion, faith, or ethics.
